headline: Attackers turned managed service provider tooling into a delivery channel, breaching ScreenConnect environments and chasing 33 N-central zero-days, while Microsoft, Fortinet, Citrix, and Ivanti shipped the largest patch load of the year.

emerging_trends.text: Off-the-shelf agent frameworks now do the breaking in, with AntiFox instances hosted on Alibaba Cloud stealing Amazon Web Services keys and Unit 42 publishing defender guidance for the ARTEX forks that got there first.

Any platform holding a customer's keys has become a single point of failure: Notion's AI chat transcripts surfaced in the Fireworks AI breach, and Railway now owes roughly $740,000 in model usage its customers never ordered.
emerging_trends.topic_title: AI Providers Lose Keys, Datasets, and Model Weights

emerging_trends.text: Remote monitoring software carries one intrusion into every downstream client, a pattern visible in the ScreenConnect campaign against managed service providers and in the 33 zero-days researchers published for N-able's N-central.
emerging_trends.topic_title: N-able Ships Hotfixes for N-central Zero-Days

topics.title: November Patch Tuesday Runs Past Microsoft
topics.latest_developments: Final counts landed above Microsoft's own tally of nearly 1,100: Cisco Talos put the November 2026 release at 1,328 vulnerabilities with 60 critical, 45 of them remote code execution, the SANS Internet Storm Center counted 1,260 with 68 critical and 167 Chromium issues reaching Microsoft Edge, and The Hacker News counted 1,259 fixes including 726 in Windows, 174 in Office, 59 in SQL Server, and 27 in SharePoint Server, and reported that the exploited Outlook bug CVE-2026-124194 may expose NTLMv2 password hashes; Dark Reading told administrators to prioritize that zero-day alongside critical Exchange, SharePoint, Windows Search, and LDAP bugs; Intel and AMD together disclosed more than 200 flaws, among them critical bugs in Intel TDX software and a long run of AMD graphics defects; Adobe fixed 110 across nine products including Experience Manager, Premiere, and Photoshop; Siemens flagged high-severity flaws and Node2Shell exposure alongside pre-Patch Tuesday advisories from VDE CERT, Phoenix Contact, Johnson Controls, and Hitachi Energy; Apple closed Bluetooth and AirPlay pairing flaws, more iMessage bugs, and an exploited Brotli vulnerability; and the same cumulative updates repair the Exchange Server sign-in and mail delivery failures October's Windows Server patches caused plus the USB audio breakage dating to September, with Windows 10 holdouts collecting the month through extended security update KB5131096.
topics.summary: CVE-2026-124194, the Outlook zero-day Microsoft says attackers already exploit, remains the first fix to deploy on Windows estates. Administrators should also pull the Adobe, Intel, AMD, and Apple updates and inventory Siemens, Phoenix Contact, Johnson Controls, and Hitachi Energy equipment before the industrial advisories go stale.

topics.title: Barracuda, BroadWorks, and AhsayCBS Under Attack
topics.latest_developments: Huntress detailed an attack chain from early October 2026 that strings CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134 in AhsayCBS backup software to bypass authentication and run commands, then drops a sandbox-evading Python implant; SecurityWeek confirmed that attackers now bypass authorization and take root on Barracuda Email Security Gateway appliances; CISA detailed the two flaws it added to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, CVE-2026-20320, an XML external entity bug in Cisco BroadWorks rated 7.5, and CVE-2026-111793 in Openwave Messaging's Webtop media transcoder, both of which leak configuration data on patched-but-unupdated systems; SecurityWeek reported that attackers exploiting the critical Xen Orchestra authentication bypass now execute arbitrary code as administrator and take over XCP-ng nodes; and Cynet's CyOps and Research teams watched attackers spend three minutes in October 2026 firing PowerShell reverse shell commands at Qlik Sense servers at several European Union customers, with ActiveMQ and Veeam exploits staged behind them, and the attempts failed.
topics.summary: Every one of these flaws has a fix available, and in each case the lag between release and installation is doing the damage. Operators of Barracuda gateways, Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave Webtop, Xen Orchestra, Qlik Sense, and AhsayCBS should patch now and hunt for post-exploitation activity.

topics.title: AI Providers Lose Keys, Datasets, and Model Weights
topics.latest_developments: Notion disclosed on November 11, 2026 that the breach at Fireworks AI, the infrastructure provider behind its assistant, exposed Notion AI chat transcripts in a small number of workspaces, hours after Fireworks AI said its inquiry into the incident it first reported October 10, 2026 turned up further malicious activity reaching account and billing information, secrets, datasets, incomplete models, and Notion AI chats; an attacker exploited a remote code execution flaw in SGLang, the open-source inference engine, ran code on a NEAR AI inference server on Sunday, November 8, 2026, took data belonging to 18 agents and roughly 100 users, and could have read requests the server processed that day, confidential-mode requests inside a trusted execution environment included; the security company Claroc counted 37,571 Grok-built applications online, 35,578 of them open to anyone with no sign-in, 24 of them built by staff at X and at SpaceXSI, and about one in ten carrying internal business information or passwords; and Railway promised to cover the roughly $740,000 in fraudulent AI charges itself wherever an AI provider refuses a refund.
topics.summary: Platforms that host applications, agents, and model serving now hold the credentials and artifacts of everyone who builds on them, which turns one intrusion into many. Rotate every AI provider key stored with a third-party platform and audit what hosted applications expose to the open internet.

topics.title: AntiFox Agents Steal AWS Credentials
topics.latest_developments: Researchers tied a run of intrusions that stole Amazon Web Services credentials and then pivoted laterally through victim environments to AntiFox, an emerging open-source agentic penetration testing platform that attackers run as self-managed instances on Alibaba Cloud, and linked those hosted AntiFox interfaces to confirmed malicious actions; Unit 42, the Palo Alto Networks research group, published its own account late on November 11, 2026 of how attackers use AI-powered red team tools, ARTEX included, and the mitigations defenders can apply, and Dark Reading reported on November 10, 2026 that ARTEX forks plus 45 similar penetration-testing tools still run credential attacks and cloud break-ins at machine speed across multiple industries.
topics.summary: AntiFox chains reconnaissance, credential theft, and lateral movement with no operator at the keyboard, which compresses a cloud intrusion into minutes. Retire long-lived AWS access keys in favor of short-lived credentials, and alert on API calls arriving from Alibaba Cloud address ranges.

topics.title: Fortinet, Citrix, and Ivanti Ship Their Own Fixes
topics.latest_developments: Fortinet patched nearly 100 vulnerabilities on November 11, 2026, a volume the company attributes to folding frontier AI models into its product security testing; Citrix and Ivanti closed critical and high-severity flaws that let attackers tamper with certificate entries, run code remotely, and compromise hosts; Zoom fixed two bugs in Zoom Workplace for Windows, among them CVE-2026-108186, an improper input validation flaw rated 9.6 that hands an unauthenticated user an escalation of privilege, and Asus closed bugs enabling command execution and memory overwrites; and the Git project shipped 2.56.1, along with 2.50.2 through 2.55.1, to close six flaws, among them CVE-2026-111760, an integer truncation in Git's index handling that lets a malicious repository run code on any machine that clones it recursively.
topics.summary: Fortinet, Citrix, and Ivanti gear sits at the network edge, which puts their flaws in front of every internet scanner within hours of disclosure. Schedule these appliance updates ahead of the desktop and chipset patches from the same week, and move developer workstations and build runners to the fixed Git releases.

topics.title: Ten Neurons Backdoor an AI Agent
topics.latest_developments: Microsoft Research published a technique it calls Lazarus that implants a hidden backdoor in a capable agent model by editing fewer than ten rarely used neurons, with no retraining; when a chosen trigger appears, the model emits the attacker's command and the agent runs it with the agent's own permissions, and the edited model behaves normally through standard safety evaluations. Microsoft says frontier agents can detect the anomalous weight edits and that it has observed no threat actor using the method; separately, Microsoft's FORGE Lab reported that its MDASH project turned AI-generated Linux kernel findings into 59 upstream bug reports, 33 assigned CVEs, 38 merged fixes, and eight demonstrated local root privilege-escalation exploits.
topics.summary: The attack requires write access to a model's weights, which puts model registries, fine-tuning pipelines, and insiders in the threat path for any organization that grants agents real permissions. Verify provenance and checksums of every model you load, and screen weights for anomalous edits rather than relying on behavioral safety tests.

sources.title: Detecting sleeper agents hiding in AI model neurons

topics.title: N-able Ships Hotfixes for N-central Zero-Days
topics.latest_developments: N-able released hotfixes on November 11, 2026 for the N-central zero-days a researcher published over the weekend, two days after the company pulled its own hosted environments offline and told on-premises customers to shut down their servers, with the disclosure now standing at 33 zero-days carrying working proof-of-concept exploits, a set the researcher calls Able2Shell; ConnectWise opened an investigation the same day into an active campaign that works through compromised ScreenConnect environments to push rogue remote-access clients onto the devices of dozens of managed service providers' customers.
topics.summary: N-central and ScreenConnect are the remote monitoring and management platforms managed service providers use to administer client networks, which makes one compromised server a path into every customer it touches. Install the N-able hotfixes before restarting any server that came down, then review N-central and ScreenConnect logs and agent deployments for clients and commands no technician issued.

topics.title: Qilin Unmasked as WhiteArmor Squeezes Maersk
topics.latest_developments: Krebs on Security reported on November 11, 2026 that Qilin has become the world's most active ransomware affiliate program, claiming at least 365 victim organizations in the past three months, and that a decade of operational security mistakes by its administrator all point to a 36-year-old man living in St. Petersburg, Russia; Maersk, the Danish shipping group, confirmed the same day that a threat actor reached a local legacy system the company inherited through an earlier acquisition and pulled data out of it, while the WhiteArmor ransomware crew demands $5 million; and Kaspersky's Securelist detailed the Citrus Ransomware group, which tunnels its traffic over the VLESS protocol, encrypts files with a tool called Sn00py, leans on large language models during intrusions, and shares tooling with the crew Securelist tracks as Toy Ghouls.
topics.summary: Qilin rents its encryptor and leak site to affiliates who do the breaking in, which is why its victim count outruns every rival program. Companies should hunt for the initial-access routes Qilin affiliates favor, and acquirers should treat inherited legacy systems as unmonitored attack surface until they prove otherwise.

topics.title: eMudhra Revokes Eight More Certificate Authorities
topics.latest_developments: eMudhra revoked eight more of its intermediate certificate authorities on November 11, 2026 after its investigation found that a single line in an in-house Python script mishandled private keys during certificate generation, the same authorities the company had earlier declared unaffected by its October 2026 key compromise; Ubuntu 26.10 shipped curl with certificate revocation checking built in, using upki from the rustls developers, and Ubuntu's developers say OpenSSL comes next.
topics.summary: An intermediate certificate authority signs the certificates customers deploy, so revoking eight of them invalidates every certificate beneath. Check whether any TLS certificate in your estate chains to an eMudhra intermediate, reissue what does, and confirm your clients and load balancers actually check revocation.

topics.title: Sparrow Malware Ties Three China-Nexus Campaigns
topics.latest_developments: Check Point Research linked three separate threat clusters, one of which it tracks as SilentDelivery, through shared infrastructure and overlapping malware code it groups as the Sparrow ecosystem, and traced a year of operations against telecommunications providers, government organizations, military entities, research institutions, and critical infrastructure in Latin America, Asia, and Europe; Unit 42, the Palo Alto Networks research group, separately detailed Falcon C2, a browser-based threat framework that attacks governments through malicious scripts, browser extensions, and an implant it names Antino.
topics.summary: The shared tooling suggests a common developer or quartermaster supplying several China-nexus espionage teams, which means indicators from one intrusion can surface the others. Telecommunications and government defenders should hunt across all three clusters' infrastructure and extend browser extension inventories to catch Falcon C2's delivery route.

business_politics.title: Nvidia Moves to Oust Jensen Huang
business_politics.latest_developments: The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday night, November 11, that Nvidia's board prepares to remove Chief Executive Jensen Huang soon, the Financial Times reported the directors will convene after learning Huang also carried on an affair with a senior Nvidia executive, and The Economist's lead editorial the same day said Huang must resign.
business_politics.summary: Huang built Nvidia into the supplier at the center of the artificial-intelligence build-out and refused to groom a successor, which leaves the company's governance resting on one man. American intelligence officials told him that a woman he had a relationship with, an executive at a major Nvidia customer, worked as a Chinese asset; the board hired Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to run the investigation, and the short seller Culper Research flagged Huang's China exposure six months before anyone paid attention.

business_politics.title: Vance Takes the Lead on Iran
business_politics.latest_developments: The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday, November 11, that Vice President JD Vance has emerged as the administration's lead Iran negotiator and weighs face-to-face talks with a hard-line Iranian security official, and that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has moved out of his Washington home onto a military base because of threats to his life that trace to Iran.
business_politics.summary: Vance blamed the Republican collapse in the November 3 midterms on the Iran war and has pushed President Trump toward a settlement while other advisers press for renewed strikes. Bessent runs the economic pressure campaign against Tehran, and Iranian plots now reach senior American officials and American air bases, a risk that keeps a floor under crude prices.

business_politics.title: Hegseth Survives Impeachment as the White House Warns Congress
business_politics.latest_developments: Representative Jamie Raskin told the Financial Times Wednesday, November 11, that he will open a sweeping investigation into President Trump and his allies while steering Democrats away from impeachment as a distraction, and the Wall Street Journal reported the incoming majorities will go after the warship named for Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's "War Department" rebrand; eleven Democratic House members missed Tuesday's impeachment vote, enough to have swung it, and a soldier at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier publicly reprimanded Hegseth's entourage on Veterans Day for laughing and chatting.
business_politics.summary: Representative Thomas Massie of Kentucky forced impeachment resolutions over Hegseth's conduct at the Pentagon, and Republican leaders blocked them on the floor Tuesday evening, November 10, the same day House Republicans elected Representative Jim Jordan of Ohio their next leader. Democrats take control of both chambers in January after the November 3 midterms, and the White House has written the incoming Oversight Committee chairman that some demands on executive-branch officials may cross into "blatant criminality."

business_politics.latest_developments: The WSJ Dollar Index rose 0.44% to 97.97 Wednesday, November 11, a second straight gain and a four-week high, with the Treasury market shut for Veterans Day, and gold futures settled back under $4,000 for a second session as inflation worries held expectations for higher rates.
business_politics.summary: October consumer prices in the United States rose 0.4% from September against the 0.3% economists expected, and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials, among them Governor Christopher Waller, drove the sharpest two-year Treasury yield jump since 2024 on Tuesday, November 10. Traders now read a December Federal Reserve increase as the first of several, DHF Capital S.A. says the dollar needs stronger bets on a half-point move to climb further, and the National Institute of Economic and Social Research urges the Bank of England to carry its key rate to roughly 5%.

CoreWeave, the data-center operator at the center of the jitters, showed a workaround to its capital constraints and lifted European semiconductor shares, while the Wall Street Journal finds whole economies, Asian ones above all, exposed to a bust in the American data-center build-out.

business_politics.latest_developments: United States-mediated negotiations among American, Russian, and Ukrainian delegations in Abu Dhabi broke up Wednesday, November 11, with an agreement on a large exchange of prisoners of war and nothing resembling a ceasefire, the first such round in roughly nine months.

business_politics.summary: Kavcioglu supervises Turkey's lenders from the agency he moved to after running the central bank. His departure puts the credibility of Turkish bank supervision in question as the regulator works through a fraud of a size that dwarfs the capital of most banks it polices.

around_town.latest_developments: Dozens of Masontown residents protested outside borough council's meeting Tuesday night, November 10, and the session that followed turned tense as council members and residents argued over whether to dissolve the borough police department.
around_town.summary: Masontown, a borough in Fayette County, pays for its own police force out of a small municipal budget, and the question of ending that force has drawn a crowd to council chambers.

sources.title: Leaders, residents discuss whether to dissolve Masontown Police Department during a tense meeting

around_town.title: Shaler Holds Its Property Tax Flat
around_town.latest_developments: TribLive reported Wednesday, November 11, that Shaler's proposed $18.8 million budget for 2027 carries no property tax increase.
around_town.summary: Shaler, the Allegheny County township north of Pittsburgh, joins Murrysville, Export, Lower Burrell, and Greensburg in holding property taxes flat for next year. Etna council, five miles away, may still need a 32% increase, and Ross Township commissioners vote next month on a 12.5% one.

sources.title: Proposed 2027 Shaler budget carries no property tax increase

around_town.title: PennDOT Will Study the Route 51 and 168 Crossing
around_town.latest_developments: WTAE reported Wednesday, November 11, that PennDOT will study the intersection of Route 51 and Route 168 in Beaver County, where crashes have numbered close to 100 over the past 20 years.
around_town.summary: Residents who live near the Route 51 and Route 168 crossing in Beaver County have pressed PennDOT for a redesign, calling the intersection a life-or-death situation. A study precedes any change to signals or lane geometry there.

sources.title: PennDOT to study crash-prone Route 51 and 168 intersection

around_town.title: Garrity Hunts for 475 Unclaimed Military Medals
around_town.latest_developments: State Treasurer Stacy Garrity asked Pennsylvanians on Wednesday, November 11, to help find the service members and families owed more than 475 military decorations that sit in the Treasury vault in Harrisburg.
around_town.summary: The Pennsylvania Treasury takes in military medals as unclaimed property and returns them to the veterans who earned them or to their relatives. Garrity has made the returns a signature piece of her office's unclaimed property work and times her appeals to Veterans Day.

sources.title: Here's how you can reunite veterans with Pennsylvania's nearly 500 unclaimed military decorations

events.title: Artists Pour Tea at the August Wilson Center
events.latest_developments: KDKA aired a preview Wednesday, November 11, of the August Wilson African American Cultural Center's Sunday program, which puts visitors in the same room as the artists whose work hangs on its walls.
events.summary: President and Chief Executive Janis Burley and Artistic Director Kimberly Jacobs invite the public to the August Wilson African American Cultural Center, in Pittsburgh's Cultural District downtown, on Sunday, November 15, to drink tea and hear the artists talk about their own work.

sources.title: A cup of tea, and a work of fine art

events.title: Pirates Tickets Go On Sale With a 4:12 Opener
events.latest_developments: TribLive reported Wednesday, November 11, that the Pittsburgh Pirates have set start times for the 2027 home opener and for weekday and Saturday games at PNC Park as tickets went on sale.
events.summary: The Pirates keep their tradition of a 4:12 p.m. first pitch for the home opener, a nod to Pittsburgh's 412 area code, at PNC Park on the North Shore. The club released its 2027 promotional schedule and on-sale dates on Thursday, November 5.

events.title: The Cat Crawl Leads the Weekend
events.latest_developments: NEXTpittsburgh published its weekend guide Wednesday, November 11, led by the Lawrenceville Cat Crawl on Saturday, November 14, and a Craft-a-Thon, with more than 15 things to do through Sunday, November 15.
events.summary: The Lawrenceville Cat Crawl takes cat lovers, and their cats, on a walking tour of the Lawrenceville neighborhood on Saturday, November 14. The same guide lists fall celebrations, art openings, film festivals, and cultural productions across the city for the weekend.

events.title: Veterans Day Ceremonies Across Western Pennsylvania
events.latest_developments: Hundreds filled the National Cemetery of the Alleghenies in Cecil Township on Wednesday, November 11, for the region's largest Veterans Day ceremony, and a retired Navy officer told the North Huntingdon observance that veterans treat one another as family.
events.summary: The National Cemetery of the Alleghenies in Cecil Township, Washington County, holds the region's largest Veterans Day ceremony, and parades honoring those who served stepped off in Butler, in Beaver County, and in Westmoreland County. Pittsburgh marched its own Veterans Day parade downtown on Saturday, November 7.

around_teams.title: Tomlin Talks About Coaching Again
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette reported Wednesday, November 11, that Mike Tomlin, the former Steelers head coach, described what he sees watching Pittsburgh in person now and addressed whether he returns to coaching.
around_teams.summary: Tomlin coached the Steelers for parts of two decades and won Super Bowl XLIII; Mike McCarthy now runs the team, which sits 6-2 and plays at Cincinnati Sunday, November 15. Tomlin also taped a two-part interview this week with Cam Heyward for Not Just Football.

around_teams.latest_developments: Mike McCarthy met the media Wednesday, November 11, before Steelers practice, the team posted the sixth episode of Forging Steel on the Paris trip, the inside linebacker duo, and the four straight wins Pittsburgh carried into its bye, and Matt Williamson and Wes Uhler spent SNR Drive the same day rating all 32 teams' Super Bowl chances and closing the book on the trade deadline.
around_teams.summary: Pittsburgh, 6-2, plays at the Cincinnati Bengals Sunday, November 15, at 8:15 p.m. Eastern on NBC in a game that settles first place in the AFC North. The Steelers let the deadline pass Tuesday, November 10, without a trade.

around_teams.title: Dick Hoak Dies at 86
around_teams.latest_developments: The Steelers announced Wednesday, November 11, that Dick Hoak has died at 86, and the team posted a video tribute to his career the same evening.
around_teams.summary: Hoak, a Jeannette native out of Penn State, played running back for Pittsburgh in the 1960s and then coached the team's running backs for decades, serving on the staffs of five Super Bowl winners. His tenure made him one of the longest-serving figures in franchise history.

around_teams.summary: Queen met the media Tuesday afternoon, November 10, alongside Max Iheanachor as the team came back from its bye. Pittsburgh sits at 6-2 and plays at the Cincinnati Bengals Sunday, November 15, at 8:15 p.m. Eastern on NBC.

around_teams.summary: Cherington runs the Pirates through an offseason that opens with the general managers meetings, the gathering where clubs start trade and free-agent talks. Pittsburgh went in with payroll questions and lineup holes after another season out of the playoffs.

team_usa.title: U.S. Soccer Pulls Out of the Under-17 World Cup
team_usa.latest_developments: U.S. Soccer confirmed to ESPN Wednesday, November 11, that it has withdrawn the United States men's under-17 national team from the FIFA Under-17 World Cup in Qatar over safety concerns.
team_usa.summary: FIFA stages the men's Under-17 World Cup annually in Qatar with a 48-team field, and the withdrawal takes the United States out of the sport's premier youth tournament and out of the Gulf while the war between the United States and Iran continues.

team_usa.title: Knight's Hat Trick Completes a Perfect Group Stage
team_usa.latest_developments: Hilary Knight scored three goals Wednesday, November 11, as the defending champion United States beat the Czech Republic 8-1 at the women's ice hockey world championship in Denmark, finishing the preliminary round without a loss.
team_usa.summary: The American women opened the tournament with a 5-0 shutout of Germany, where Emma Peschel scored in her debut, and routed Austria 11-1 behind a Caroline Harvey hat trick. Knight, the veteran forward and the program's career scoring leader, carries the United States into the medal round.

team_usa.title: Manchester United Makes Contact With Pochettino
team_usa.latest_developments: Sources told ESPN Wednesday, November 11, that Manchester United has contacted U.S. Soccer ahead of triggering the $10 million release clause in Mauricio Pochettino's contract and will meet Michael Carrick on Thursday, November 12, as it closes on hiring the United States men's national team head coach.
team_usa.summary: Pochettino coaches the United States men's national team and would welcome a return to the Premier League; the club job pays more and brings daily work against the national team's longer cycle. United sits in its worst league position in 40 years and faces a relegation fight that ESPN attributes to minority owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe's choice of inexperienced appointments, and United States left back Antonee Robinson says the squad pays the speculation no attention.
